body:
Filed mechanically by the **queue steward** Routine seat (anchor #5810) under the #6162 window-closure trigger: `.objectui-sha` lags objectui `main` **and** the objectui merge queue is empty. ⛔ The steward only files — it never executes the bump.

## Lag reading (2026-08-08 09:1xZ)

| | |
|---|---|
| `.objectui-sha` on objectstack `origin/main` | `0cf8f0f70d1040a63316e0c55cb2fd2e87989d73` |
| objectui `origin/main` head | `918888a30ca0c4240818f77b8225875078002aca` (08:45:22Z) |
| REST `compare` | `status: ahead`, **ahead_by 4**, behind_by 0 |

## Why now

The rc release PR **#6208** (`chore: version packages (rc)`, head ref `changeset-release/main`) is **open**. `Console Pin Freshness` runs in the **blocking** lane there — the lane test in `.github/workflows/objectui-pin-freshness.yml` matches on `HEAD_REF = changeset-release/main`. And the verdict in `scripts/check-objectui-pin-fresh.mjs` is `stale` whenever compare status is `ahead`, **independently of whether the range declares changesets** (red condition 1 of #3340 P0: "the judging ref is AHEAD of the pin — frontend commits are unbundled"). So this 4-commit lag is enough to hold the release lane red; it does not become urgent only once a changeset appears.

## What rides this bump (verified at filing)

**No `.changeset/*.md` files were added anywhere in the range** — `git diff --name-status 0cf8f0f7..918888a -- .changeset` is empty. The four commits:

- `f710fc4` — ci: subscribe the four gate workflows to `merge_group`, move ci/lint path filtering into the jobs (objectui#3523 steps 1-2, PR #3722)
- `ae3bd96` — test(app-shell): second `MetadataRedirectStub` in `pseudoRouteSegments` synced and pinned by a full-chain assertion (objectui#3669)
- `15a0d36` — docs(console): drop the `objectstack.config.ts` ghost, the dead app-creation entries, the routing-table overreach (objectui#3580); also touches `apps/console/tsconfig.json`
- `918888a` — fix(fields): echo stored date values in the sub-grid's native date cells (objectui#3718) — user-visible `packages/fields` fix, **carries no changeset**

⚠️ The last line is a reading, not a verdict: whether objectui#3718 should have declared a changeset is the objectui lane's call, not this chore's. Re-read the range at claim time — it grows.

## How

Run `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` from a dedicated objectstack worktree with a sibling objectui checkout at the **current** objectui `origin/main` head (re-read at claim time; `918888a` as of filing). Precedents: #6159, #6097. Do not hand-edit `packages/console/dist` (untracked; built by `build-console.sh`).

## Caveats

- **#6099** (open): the bump digest only flags `major`-declared breaking changes, while objectui declares v17-window breaking as `minor` + body annotation. Checked at filing: the range declares **no changesets at all**, so there is nothing to mis-classify today — re-verify if the range has grown by execution time.
- **Ordering**: merge **before** #6208 lands; that PR regenerates on every push to `main` and must include this bump's `@objectstack/console` changeset.
- **Window-closure basis**: objectui had zero `gh-readonly-queue/*` branches at both readings this round. Note that `f710fc4` (in this very range) subscribes objectui's four gate workflows to `merge_group` — objectui is adopting a merge queue, so "queue empty" stops being trivially true for that repo from here on.
